name: URL Shortener
description: Turn long web addresses into short links and count how often each one is followed
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may follow short links and read the list of recent links; require auth for creating and deleting short links; admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account
POST /api/urls stores original_url for the signed-in user and gives it a unique short_code of 6 characters from A-Z, a-z and 0-9; a randomly drawn code that is already taken is drawn again
URL validation: original_url is required, at most 2048 characters, and must be a valid URL; anything else answers 400
Every link in a response carries short_url, the path /r/<short_code> on this app, so the frontend can build the full short address from its own origin

Following a short link: GET /r/<short_code> (outside /api, served before the frontend's history fallback) answers 302 with Location set to original_url and adds 1 to click_count; an unknown or deactivated code answers 404
GET /api/urls returns active links, newest first; ?page= and ?page_size= page the result (page_size default 20, at most 100), and total counts every active link
Only the user who created a link may delete it (403 for anyone else); DELETE /api/urls/:id removes the link permanently
Deactivated links (is_active false) are left out of GET /api/urls, answer 404 on GET /api/urls/:id and no longer redirect; the admin overview still lists them
Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-owner or a non-admin, 404 for unknown ids or codes
frontend_requirements: Everyone sees the list of recent links with their click counts; signed-in users also get the shorten form and a delete button on their own links, and visitors see a 'Sign in to shorten links' prompt in place of the form
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out

Shorten form: a field for the long address and a 'Shorten' button; on success show the full short address with a copy-to-clipboard button, and show the API's validation message when the address is rejected
Recent links list: short address, original address (truncated with the full value on hover), click count and creation date, with previous/next paging
Delete asks for confirmation first and removes the link from the list
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every link, active or not, with its owner and click count, and total, active and inactive counts
Toggle a link's active status from the overview

api_endpoints.description: Shorten an address for the signed-in user
List active links, newest first, paged
One active link with its click count
Delete one of the signed-in user's links

data_models.name: ShortUrl
data_models.description: A long address and the short code that redirects to it

fields.original_url: string (required, a valid URL, max 2048 chars)
fields.short_code: string (unique, exactly 6 characters from A-Z, a-z, 0-9)
fields.user_id: integer (references the signed-in user who created it)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false hides the link from public endpoints and stops its redirect)

admin_api_endpoints.description: Admin overview: every link with counts
